new.s: Which Part of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 deals with authorisation of expenditure and distribution of revenues?
new.x: Part V covers expenditure and distribution of revenues; Part VI is assets and liabilities and Part VIII is services.

new.s: Which Section of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 provides for a separate High Court for Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Section 31 provides a separate High Court for AP; Section 30 kept the Hyderabad High Court common in the meantime.

new.s: From which date did the High Court of Andhra Pradesh begin functioning with its principal seat at Amaravati?
new.x: After the Presidential order of 26 December 2018, the AP High Court began functioning at Amaravati on 1 January 2019.
new.angle: U0577 #8 Amaravati High Court -> start date

new.s: Which training centre in Hyderabad was made a common training centre for both successor States for a maximum of three years under the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014?
o: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy
new.x: The Act let the Greyhound Training Centre, Hyderabad, serve both States as a common training centre for up to three years.
new.angle: U0577 PYQ yd61217c1616 Greyhound -> common centre

new.s: Under Section 8 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014, who appoints the two advisors who assist the common Governor?
o: The Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh
new.x: For his special responsibility in the common capital, the Governor is helped by two advisors appointed by the Centre.

new.s: What does Section 95 of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 deal with?
o: Equal opportunities for quality higher education
new.x: Section 95 ensures equal opportunities for quality higher education to all students of both States.

new.s: How many districts formed the State of Telangana under Section 3 of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014?
new.x: Section 3 formed Telangana from 10 districts; residual Andhra Pradesh had 13 districts.
new.angle: U0577 PYQ y57af69cb543 districts of successor States

new.s: Which Schedule of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 lists 107 State institutions, such as APSCHE, whose facilities continue for both States?
new.x: The Tenth Schedule lists 107 State institutions (e.g. APSCHE, Shilparamam) whose facilities continue for both States.
new.angle: U0577 PYQ y304fb0ea29d Schedule X -> 107 institutions

new.s: Under Section 26 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014, to how many seats can the Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly be raised from 175?
new.x: Section 26 allows delimitation to raise the AP Assembly from 175 to 225 seats, subject to Article 170.

new.s: Which Constitutional Amendment ended the nomination of one Anglo-Indian MLA provided under Section 18 of the AP Reorganisation Act?
new.x: Section 18 used Article 333 for Anglo-Indian nomination; the 104th Amendment ended this provision.

new.s: Under Section 3 of the AP Reorganisation Act, as amended by the Polavaram Ordinance, villages of which district in the Polavaram submergence area stayed with Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: The Polavaram Ordinance amended Section 3 so that Khammam villages in the Polavaram submergence area stayed with AP.
new.angle: U0577 notes gap Sec 3 -> Khammam villages

new.s: Where is the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) set up for Andhra Pradesh under the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 located?
new.x: The IIT for Andhra Pradesh is at Tirupati, which also has the IISER.

new.s: In which city is the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) of Andhra Pradesh located?
new.x: The IIM of Andhra Pradesh is at Visakhapatnam, which also has the IIPE.

new.s: Which of the following divisions is NOT part of the South Coast Railway zone?
new.x: South Coast Railway (HQ Visakhapatnam) has the Guntakal, Guntur, Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam divisions; Secunderabad is not one of them.

new.s: How much total special assistance had been released to Andhra Pradesh by March 2018, including Rs 2,500 crore for the capital?
new.x: By March 2018 the total special assistance released was Rs 12,476.76 crore, of which Rs 2,500 crore was for the capital.

new.s: In which year did the Supreme Court rule that APSCHE assets go by location while its cash and bank balances are shared by population ratio?
new.x: The Supreme Court's APSCHE ruling of 2016 set the location rule for assets and population ratio for cash balances.

new.s: How many institutions did Schedule X of the AP Reorganisation Act have after 35 more were added by notification in May 2015?
new.x: Schedule X had 107 institutions as enacted; 35 more were added on 7 May 2015, making 142.

new.x: The Pratyush Sinha Committee on allocation of IAS, IPS and IFoS officers was formed under Section 80.

new.s: In what ratio (AP : Telangana) did the Union Home Ministry order on APSCHE share the cash balances?
new.x: The MHA order gave APSCHE assets to the State of location and shared cash balances 52:48 between AP and Telangana.

new.s: Which Finance Commission recommended a post-devolution revenue deficit grant of Rs 22,113 crore for Andhra Pradesh?

new.s: How much interest did Andhra Pradesh pay in 2024-25?
new.x: AP paid Rs 32,944 crore as interest in 2024-25, a committed cost that crowds out capital outlay.

new.s: On the banks of which river is Amaravati, the capital of Andhra Pradesh, located?
new.x: The AP Cabinet chose Amaravati on the Krishna, between Vijayawada and Guntur.

new.s: Which concession was given to farmers who pooled their land for the Amaravati capital?
o: Exemption from capital gains tax and stamp duty on first sale
Income tax holiday for ten years
Exemption from GST on farm inputs
new.x: Land-pooling farmers were exempted from capital gains tax and stamp duty on the first sale.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's debt is projected at about Rs 7.11 lakh crore. About what share of its GSDP is this?
new.x: AP debt is projected at Rs 7.11 lakh crore, about 36% of GSDP, raising worries about loan-based capital funding.

new.s: Which agency funded the South Asia Poverty Alleviation Programme (SAPAP) in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: SAPAP was funded by the UNDP, the only UN agency among AP's external funders.

new.x: The AP Rural Inclusive Growth Project is a World Bank project implemented by SERP.

new.x: ADB gave a results-based loan of $788.8 million; the World Bank's loan was $800 million.

new.x: The World Bank approved the $800 million Amaravati loan on 19 December 2024.
